checks.explanation: Control and locate missing components before continuing the work.

Stop work in the area and report the issue for a search
Close the panel so it cannot be seen
Mark the work complete

objectives: Menjaga komponen kecil serta memakai alat dan nilai yang ditetapkan dalam instruksi kerja.
Memilih tindakan yang menjaga keselamatan, mutu, dan batas kewenangan.
Menggunakan ungkapan Jepang sederhana yang terkait dengan pekerjaan.
lessons.response: Stop work in that area, notify the supervisor, and follow the foreign-object search procedure before work resumes.
lessons.scenario: A screw falls into a narrow space and is not found during the initial check.

sections.body: Basic work may involve bolts, screws, nuts, locking devices, and mechanical measurements. Follow current instructions for cleanliness, sequence, tool size, and locking method. Limits and torque values depend on the task. Do not assume that similar-looking components have the same specifications.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: Prepare a container so small items are not left in the aircraft. Follow the documented sequence, tools, and values. If a thread is damaged, a tool is unsuitable, or a measurement is outside limits, do not repair it outside your assigned task. Mark it and report it to a senior technician.
sections.title: Applying the Procedures at Work

steps: Baca metode dan batas pada instruksi kerja
Siapkan alat serta hitung kelengkapannya
Kerjakan sesuai urutan, nilai, dan teknik
Catat hasil dan laporkan masalah
lessons.title: Mechanical Fastening and Measurement

lessons.caution: Do not measure a circuit that has not been made safe or alter a connector to clear an alarm.

checks.explanation: Record results factually and have authorized personnel assess them.
options: Record the result and submit it to an authorized technician
Change the connection until the reading is normal
Delete the value
Declare it ready to fly
checks.prompt: What should be done with an abnormal electrical measurement?

checks.explanation: A burning smell is a hazard that must be made safe and investigated.
options: Touch the connector to check for heat
Stop, do not touch it, and report it to a supervisor
Spray cleaning fluid
Close the work card

checks.explanation: Sequence taught: Match the circuit and measurement points to the work card → Confirm the tool, safe conditions, and authorization → Record the results and any abnormal signs → Stop and report the issue to an authorized technician.

objectives: Mencatat hasil pengukuran listrik dan meneruskan anomali tanpa menebak penyebab.
Memilih tindakan yang menjaga keselamatan, mutu, dan batas kewenangan.
Menggunakan ungkapan Jepang sederhana yang terkait dengan pekerjaan.
lessons.response: Stop measuring, do not touch the connector, and report the smell and readings to the maintenance supervisor.
lessons.scenario: The electrical reading is unstable, and there is a burning smell near the connector.

sections.body: Aircraft electrical measurements must follow the specified instructions, test points, tools, and circuit conditions. Competent staff perform system isolation and inspection. Record values and units. Stop work if readings are abnormal, wires are worn, there is a burning smell, or a connector is loose; do not alter a connection to make results appear normal.
sections.title: Work Concepts and Standards

sections.body: Check the circuit identity on the work card, confirm it is safe, and measure only within your assigned task. If the reading is unstable or outside limits, stop and record the facts. Refer it to a senior technician for evaluation and a repair decision.
